en-US.description: An independent agent workspace and full harness for coding, research, and other project work.
en-US.longDescription: Varin is an independent agent workspace and full harness for coding, research, and other project work, centered on local and desktop experiences. It bundles the Pi runtime: the model and provider stack, session tree, package manager, and extension model remain Pi-owned, while Varin owns the surrounding tool environment, working state, recovery, retrieval, context policy, task governance, and workbench surfaces. Varin ships two first-party working shapes: an Agent Workspace centered on sessions, tasks, and context, and an IDE Workbench centered on editors, search, Git, diagnostics, and debugging with the agent as a dockable panel.
en-US.releaseNotes:
Keep the conversation open while Varin works. This release brings task progress, replies, files, and connected desktops into the same workspace, with more control over the conversation history itself.
Stay in the conversation
- Send a follow-up while Varin is working. New messages guide the current work by default. To handle a message after the current turn, use the send menu or press Alt+Enter. Varin and ordinary Agent chats have separate defaults.
- Go from overview to the original task. Switch between work from this conversation and everything the Bot is following. Open a task beside the chat to see its replies, questions, permission requests, and outputs. Reply to the Agent from there, or open the full workbench and return to the same conversation afterward.
- Open the files or desktop you need. Task details, file spaces, and connected desktops open in tabs alongside the conversation. You can attach original files to a new assignment or send them to an Agent already working. Attachments remain accessible from the chat and collaboration panel.
Revisit a decision or clean up old work
- Conversation tree. See where a conversation branched and open a different route. Rewinding preserves the previous route, so you can revisit it after taking the conversation in another direction.
- Sidebar actions. Right-click a Varin conversation to rename, pin, archive, restore, or delete it. Archived conversations stay under their Bot. You can also delete an individual branch after its work has stopped. Deleting the current branch returns to the main conversation, and other branches keep their shared history.
Work with more than plain text
- Varin can present a comparison or choice directly in a reply. Explore the options in place, or bring a selection into the composer to edit before sending. Question cards let you add detail when you need it.
- The composer organizes slash commands, skills, and @ references separately. Activity summaries use a clearer hierarchy, with quieter styling for inline code and fewer repeated labels in search results.
Search connections and external agents
- Set up multiple web search connections and choose a default and fallback order. Search results retain the source and page they came from. When a connection needs a key, Varin can open a private input so the key goes directly to the Host.
- Codex, Claude Code, Pi, and ACP sessions expose the model, thinking, and mode controls their backends support. Connection status and recovery are visible from the composer. On Windows, detection can also find the default Codex desktop CLI and native Claude Code installation outside PATH.

zh-CN.description: 面向编程与科研的独立 Agent 工作台与完整 Harness。
zh-CN.longDescription: Varin 是一个独立的 Agent 工作台与完整 Harness，面向编程、科研和其他项目工作，以本地和桌面体验为中心。它内置 Pi 运行时；模型与提供商栈、会话树、包管理器和扩展模型仍由 Pi 提供，而 Varin 负责周围的工具环境、工作状态、恢复、检索、上下文策略、任务治理和工作台界面。Varin 自带两套官方工作形态：以会话、任务和上下文为中心的 Agent Workspace，以及以编辑器、搜索、Git、诊断和调试为中心、把智能体作为可停靠面板的 IDE Workbench。
zh-CN.name: Varin
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Varin 在做事时，聊天可以继续。 这一版把任务进展、回信、文件和电脑放到聊天旁边，也补齐了会话树、归档和分支删除这些日常操作。
一边聊，一边跟进工作
- 任务进行中可以补充要求。 Varin 默认把新消息交给当前工作。想等这一轮结束再处理，可以用发送菜单或 Alt+Enter。Varin 与普通 Agent 对话可以分别设置默认行为。
- 从概览进入原任务。 侧栏可切换本会话的工作和整个 Bot 正在跟进的工作。点开任务就能在聊天旁看回信、提问、权限请求和产物，也可以直接回复执行的 Agent。需要看完整过程时再进入工作台，回来还能接着聊。
- 在聊天旁打开文件和电脑。 任务详情、文件空间和已连接的电脑可以各开一个页签。原始附件可以随新任务交办，也可以补发给正在工作的 Agent，之后仍能从聊天或协作面板找到。
回到分岔点，也能收拾旧会话
- 会话树可以查看从哪里分出了不同路线，也能直接切到另一条路线。回退会保留原路线，改了方向之后依然可以回去看。
- 侧栏右键支持重命名、置顶、归档、恢复和删除会话。归档内容收在所属 Bot 下。分支上的工作结束或停止后，可以单独删除该分支。删掉正在看的分支会回到主会话，其他分支仍保留共享历史。
在对话里直接比较和选择
- Varin 可以在回复中呈现可切换的比较或选项。可以先就地看不同结果，再把选择带进输入框，改好后发送。回答问题时也能按需展开补充说明。
- 输入框把斜杠命令、技能和 @ 引用分开组织。聊天里的活动摘要、行内代码和检索结果也调整了层次，让正文和来源更容易扫读。
搜索连接和外部 Agent
- 可以配置多个联网搜索连接，并指定默认和备用顺序。搜索结果保留实际来源与页面，方便继续查看。需要填写密钥时，可由 Varin 打开私密输入框，密钥直接交给 Host。
- Codex、Claude Code、Pi 和 ACP 会话按后端实际能力提供模型、思考和模式选项。输入框旁可以查看连接状态和重连入口。Windows 也能在 PATH 之外查找默认的 Codex 桌面版 CLI 和原生安装的 Claude Code。
